Job Title: Software Developer 

 Location: Lisle, IL 60532
 Responsibilities: 

 • Design, develop, and deploy Java/J2EE applications and modules
 • Participate in system design and regular code review
 • Design, develop, and deploy Java applications and modules
 • Participate in system design and regular code review
 • Collect requirements and document the software artifacts

 Required Skills: 

 • Java/J2EE Programming [5+ Years]
 • HTML5 [3+ Year Must]
 • AngularJS [2+ Years Must]
 • Spring MVC 
 • Spring Boot
 • WebService : SOAP/REST 
 • PL/SQL Programming
 • JMS [Java Messaging System]
 • JPA [Java Persistence]
 • Maven
 • GitHub
 • Jenkins
 • MySQL
 • Rally - Agile Story board
 • Cloud technology 

   Qualifications: 
 • BS in Computer Science or equivalent
 • 5+ years of experience in Java application development
 • Highly proficient in SQL
 • Excellent analytical and communication (both verbal and written) skills
 • Innovative thinking and vision
 • Solid understanding of technology
 • Ability to meet deadlines and be accountable
 • Must have a strong sense of ownership, urgency and initiative
 • Experience with agile software development methodologies (scrum etc)
 • Good written and oral communication skills
